title: Mixed Event — Unnamed Harmony — Episode3 What I Can Do

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has decided to try and go pro, and is practicing with more effort than ever. To make their own song to perform at shows, they decide to each come up with different parts to compare. Wanting to be of help to the band, Saki works harder than anyone else on her contribution, but...

rows.Line: A few days later
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, let's end things here for today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Nice work, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Great job!
And it's sooo hot!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. You were really giving it 110% today, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I thought so too. You made it so much fun to drum to your beat.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. That's because it's so much to play like this with everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But still, I fell way behind everyone today in some spots...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (That means I need to practice even more...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Uh, Saki...
After practice the other day, did you stay behind to keep working on your part?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Yeah, I did.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Even when we don't have practice together, I still try to play my synth as much as I can. Why do you ask?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You just seemed a little tired is all. Are you sure you're feeling okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah! I'm being careful like I said♪
I'm even taking fewer shifts at work because we're practicing so much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's good but try not to overdo it, okay? You're free to say so if things aren't alright.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know♪ Thanks, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're also sharing the phrases we came up with after this, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right. I came up with some ideas, but how about the rest of you...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I have a couple. It was more of a challenge than I expected...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh! Oh! Me next!
I came up with three!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That's amazing...!
I could only come up with one.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's your first time, so one is more than plenty.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It'd be nice to have Miku and the others hear what we came up with too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure... But I am a little worried about having everyone hear something I made myself, so I'm sort of glad we're doing this today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, and we can go in the same order as we did just now. I'll start.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That should be everything...
So what did everyone think...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I really liked Ichi's second one!
The part when it switches to a minor key sounded so cool!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too. I thought it was cool too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really? Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Actually, I wasn't really sure what to do or where to go with that part...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Maybe you tried to include too many things like you weren't sure which you should say yes or no to...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, you might be right.
I listened to quite a few songs as references and did get overloaded a little...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Overall, I thought it sounded pretty good.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay... But I feel like if we're going to be playing it together, there are better options out there.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Should we try a different one then?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
A different one...?
I had Shiho's first one as another candidate.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: About that... It's based on a song by an artist I've been heavily influenced by...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's sort of in the same boat as Ichika's. I'm not sure it's the best option for Leo/need...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It just seems even more difficult after actually putting pen to paper and listening to everything.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It sounded alright when I was putting it together, but it's not what I thought it was anymore.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree... It's hard to say what's good or bad, so it doesn't feel right to make a judgment even after listening to everything.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ugh... This is starting to make my head hurt...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It might be because we don't know exactly what kind of music we want to play yet.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The kind of music we want to play...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I never knew it was so hard to create a song from scratch...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
My thoughts exactly.
Will we ever be able to...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I think we will...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: As long as we're together, I'm sure we can! They say everybody goes through this in the beginning, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Who's “they”?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Uh, well... I forgot...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It felt like the right thing to say.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's our Saki for you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But she's right. Nobody's expecting us to come up with something right off the bat, so there's no need to rush.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's going to take time for us to figure things out, so let's just keep trying...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Someday, we will be able to compose our own songs.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right!
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, see you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Our own original song.
What would work best...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Hey, hold on a second...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: On a different note... Ichi, I came up with this tune while we were practicing. Want to hear it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: An original tune? Sure.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? Yay! I'll play it now!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh, that's really neat.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You think so? Yay! You used to write song lyrics at one point, remember? Since then I've been composing little bits in my head every now and then!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Right after we decided to form our band, I tried coming up with something and Ichi ended up really liking it...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (That one part has a good flow to it too, and I'm glad we all got to play it together...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Wait, does this mean I can pull my weight by writing songs for us...?!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (That's it! I might not be as good as everyone is when it comes to actually playing yet, so I can come up with music in the meantime!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But what kind of music suits us best?! I can't figure that part out...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wish someone would give me a hint or something...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm? This song's...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, it is!
It's that song STANDOUT played during that show!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's so cool... It's really them on the big screen... This song and video are so amazing too...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If only we could come up with a song like that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, I know!
Music Shop

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Oh, here it is!
Just the CD I was looking for♪)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Saki...?
You came here too?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Shiho!
Are you getting something too?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. This band I like released a new single and I came to buy a copy...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
And you, Saki?
That's a STANDOUT CD.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Yup! I want to use it as a reference...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, also!
Are there any albums by your favorite bands that you recommend?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Well...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
How about this...?
It's a “best of” but it has songs from when they just debuted all the way up to their new stuff.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: These three songs here are among my absolute favorites.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes. There was a time when I wasn't feeling too sure about myself, but listening to those songs made me feel so much better.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I never knew that...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Then I'll get that too!
I really want to listen to it now since you're willing to say so much about it♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Are you gonna use it as a reference too? That's awfully diligent of you...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I want to learn about as much music as I can!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh? It's already this late...?!
I'm gonna be late for my shift!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Sorry, Shiho!
I'll see you tomorrow at school!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She might be overdoing things again...
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I ended up getting two CDs. Now to check online for some videos♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll start with STANDOUT!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: STANDOUT songs have so much power behind them...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They really get the crowd going too, so that might be something I could try!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That one phrase had a nice flow to it, so I can sort of copy that and...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, that should do it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's keep listening to more songs and come up with more!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Phew. That makes six.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: All these songs have given me so many good ideas...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What do I have left...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that one song I heard during Tsukasa's show had a good melody to it too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It might not work with a band like ours, but I can still learn something from it... Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line:
Tsukasa!
What was that song you guys used during that one show...?
